title: Lot
sourceLines: .Accompanies Terah from Ur of the Chaldees to Haran Ge 11:31
.Migrates with Abraham to the land of Canaan Ge 12:4
.Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants
.Separates from Abraham, and locates in Sodom Ge 13:5-14
.Taken captive by Chedorlaomer; rescued by Abraham Ge 14:1-16
.Providentially saved from destruction in Sodom Ge 19; Lu 17:28,29
.Disobediently protests against going to the mountains, and chooses Zoar Ge 19:17-22
.His wife disobediently yearns after Sodom, and becomes a pillar of salt Ge 19:26; Lu 17:32
